Perfect — Wed 6/30 14:00 PT is on our side. I added Marissa (CS) to the thread so she can handle calendar invite and the short technical checklist.

Quick answers for Sam up front so you have context before the call:
- Default prefix/KV cache retention is session-scoped unless you enable persistent KV — we can show how a short-lived prefix cache reduces cold-start tokens while keeping storage small.
- For high ingestion bursts we often recommend a small quantized model for inference fan-out (lower cost) plus a higher-quality model for the final rank/generation stage — happy to sketch the tradeoffs in 2 slides.

Marissa — can you send a 20-minute invite for Wed 6/30 at 14:00 PT and attach the 1-page agenda + the usage snapshot?

Thanks —
Vivek
